sources.document_title: TPS1663x 60-V, 6-A Power Limiting, Surge Protection Industrial eFuse
sources.locator: Table 5-1 Pin Functions (HTSSOP column) pages 5-6; 6.1 Absolute Maximum Ratings and 6.3 Recommended Operating Conditions page 7; 6.5 Electrical Characteristics pages 8-9; 6.6 Timing Requirements pages 9-10; PWP0020T example board layout
sources.evidence_extract: TPS16630 HTSSOP-20 (PWP): 1,2,3 IN; 4,5,17 N.C.; 6 P_IN (connect to IN); 7 UVLO; 8 OVP; 9 GND; 10 dVdT; 11 ILIM; 12 MODE; 13 SHDN; 14 IMON; 15 FLT; 16 PGOOD; 18,19,20 OUT; PowerPAD to GND plane, not the only GND connection. Abs max IN, P_IN, OUT, UVLO, FLT, PGOOD -0.3..67 V (IN, P_IN 75 V for 10 ms at 25 C); OVP, dVdT, IMON, MODE, SHDN, ILIM -0.3..5.5 V. ROC IN 4.5..60 V; ILIM 3..30 kOhm; dVdT capacitance >= 10 nF. EC -40..125 C: V(UVLOR) 1.176/1.2/1.224 V, V(UVLOF) 1.09/1.122/1.15 V; V(OVPR) 1.176/1.2/1.224 V, V(OVPF) 1.09/1.122/1.15 V; I(OL) at R(ILIM) 4.02 kOhm, VIN-VOUT 1 V 4.185/4.5/4.815 A; I(FASTRIP) 2 x I(OL); I(SCP) 45 A; RON 19/30.44/53 mOhm -40..125 C; I(dVdT) 1.775/2/2.225 uA; GAIN(dVdT) 23.5/25/26 V/V; V(SHDN) open circuit 2.48/2.7/3.3 V, V(SHUTR) 2 V max; MODE open = latch, MODE to GND = auto-retry. Timing: OVP_toff(dly) 8.5/11/14 us; soft-short response 2.2/3.2/4.5 us; hot-short 1 us. PWP0020T land: 20X 1.5 x 0.45 mm pads, 0.65 mm pitch, 5.8 mm row pitch, thermal pad exposed metal 2.96 x 2.96 mm.
